clips.title: The story
paras: In Ashenvale, Troll Charms have been taken from fallen Darkspear travelers. The Thistlefur furbolgs seized the sacred amulets after ambushing the party on its way to Zoram'gar Outpost.

Darkspear trolls carry spiritual charms as marks of dignity. Scout Mitsuwa says a troll without one is as diminished as an orc without battle scars. A party of Darkspear kin traveled through Ashenvale's canopy toward Zoram'gar Outpost when corrupted Thistlefur furbolgs ambushed and slaughtered them. Their spirits were commended to the afterlife, while the furbolgs took the charms as trophies and stashed them in chests deep within Thistlefur Hold.
